question: Who is established in samadhi, seeing by seeing?
premises: Enough of Mitra view of that.
Seen, me the seer of beings, seeing he sees.
Who, this very one, is established in samadhi.
inference: Dismissing Mitra view, the self-seeing seer stands samadhi-established.
plain_english: Enough of Mitra view of that! Seen — me, the seer of beings — seeing, he sees; who, this very one, is established in samadhi.
